action_instruction: Checking the ClayWorks Studio shipping row in the order summary
intent: whether the order summary contains the ClayWorks Studio shipping row with its displayed amount

action_params.condition: The order summary shows a shipping row labeled "Shipping · ClayWorks Studio" at "$4.50".
action_params.query: whether the order summary contains the ClayWorks Studio shipping row with its displayed amount
action_params.code_js: (() => { const labels = [...el(37).querySelectorAll('span')]; const label = labels.find(x => x.textContent.trim() === 'Shipping · ClayWorks Studio'); return !!label && !!label.nextElementSibling && label.nextElementSibling.textContent.trim() === '$4.50'; })()

action_instruction: Checking the Fernhouse Prints shipping row in the order summary
intent: whether the order summary contains the Fernhouse Prints shipping row with its displayed amount

action_params.condition: The order summary shows a separate shipping row labeled "Shipping · Fernhouse Prints" at "$6.25".
action_params.query: whether the order summary contains the Fernhouse Prints shipping row with its displayed amount
action_params.code_js: (() => { const labels = [...el(37).querySelectorAll('span')]; const label = labels.find(x => x.textContent.trim() === 'Shipping · Fernhouse Prints'); return !!label && !!label.nextElementSibling && label.nextElementSibling.textContent.trim() === '$6.25'; })()

assertion_tree.description: The order summary shows two separate shipping rows: "Shipping · ClayWorks Studio" at "$4.50" and "Shipping · Fernhouse Prints" at "$6.25".

sub_results.description: The order summary shows a shipping row labeled "Shipping · ClayWorks Studio" at "$4.50".
The order summary shows a separate shipping row labeled "Shipping · Fernhouse Prints" at "$6.25".

assertion_tree.verification: the order summary displays two separate shipping rows with the specified labels and amounts
